name: Landhaus Pichler
beschreibung: Landhaus Pichler enjoys a peaceful and sunny setting on the outskirts of Tannheim in the picturesque Tannheim Valley. This family-run guesthouse offers comfortable alpine-style rooms and spacious holiday apartments with scenic private balconies overlooking the surrounding mountain scenery. An on-site wellness area with a sauna and quiet relaxation room provides post-activity rejuvenation. A generous breakfast buffet featuring regional farm products ensures an energetic start. Summer brings hiking and cycling routes directly from the doorstep, while winter cross-country tracks and the Neunerköpfle ski area are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine guesthouse and apartments in Tannheim in the Tannheim Valley featuring a wellness area.
